_comment: COLOURS BY MEANING (2026-10-09, map legibility). One muted hue per family of the vocabulary (display hint 'family'), chosen for what the family is — not by its position in a sorted list — so a family added to the vocabulary never shifts another one's colour: a family not listed here is drawn in the neutral grey of the palette until a hue is chosen for it. A type may refine its family's hue when two kinds of the same family must be told apart on the map (sea and air transport). Shape still tells the nature (■ element, ● event, ◆ connection found by NEXUM); the selection keeps the accent and NEXUM's connections the link colour, which no family uses.

_families.place: places of reference (inhabited places, states): a pale neutral, the backdrop of everything else
_families.natural_feature: volcanoes and other natural features: rose
_families.natural_event: natural hazards (earthquakes, fires, storms, floods): teal
_families.conflict: organised violence: a muted red, as the security zones
_families.response: emergency response (mapping activations): lavender, as the other source registers of events
_families.camera: public webcams: steel blue (their own point layer keeps the colours of config/points.json)
_families.event: registers of events (not on the map): lavender
_families.government: governments and offices (not on the map): ochre
_families.observation: measured series (not on the map): grey-blue
_families.person: office holders (not on the map): taupe
_families.space: satellites (not on the map; orbits have their own layer): slate

_types.transport.port: sea transport (ports and landings): sea blue, apart from airfields
